rows.label: The New War
rows.note: unlocks Narmer Bounties from Konzu and Eudico

bonuses: Narmer Bounties have no Mastery Rank requirement.

groups.sub: or Orb Vallis, Fortuna, same rates
conditions: Only Rotation B carries the Nepheri roll; A and C give none. The bounty list's rotation timer cycles A/B/C every 150 minutes, so B is up 2.5 hours out of every 7.5.
Only stages 4 and 5 can drop it; bailing after stage 3 forfeits both rolls.
600 Endo floods about 47% of the table, so expect a lot of non-drops even on a B rotation.
bonuses: Run whichever hub is faster for you; drop rates are identical at Cetus and Fortuna.
Farm Caliban at the same time. His parts and Korumm/Verdilac share the other two rotations, and his build needs far more Isoplast, so the extra runs aren't wasted.
Complete every stage's bonus objective, and bring a credit Blessing or Prosperous Retriever for the 'collect 1,000 credits' stage.

disclosures.title: no pity system
disclosures.body: Caliban-era content predates the token shops that started with Voruna, and DE hasn't retrofitted one here. About 8 full B-rotation bounties gets you there on average, with bad luck running to several times that.
